title: GDD: 《데프콘 2: 화스트 페이스》(가제) v1.0
summary: Game design for a portrait card-defense game where players place military-role cards, merge duplicates to promote rank, and defend a guard post across 10 waves.
scope: card defense core loop (prep / battle / wave settlement)
720x1280 portrait screen layout (5 columns, deploy zone 5x3, mine zone 5x2, bench)
guard post HP and per-column last line of defense
ally cards (rifleman, sniper, snow-blower, cook, mine layer, chemical)
enemies (infantry, bio-modified dog, RPG, armored vehicle boss, chemical shelling)
screen specs (first run, lobby, briefing, HUD, shop, results, modals)
